decisions.reason: Frequent releases suggest ongoing commitment and positive early signals, so the option remains valuable and cheap to keep.
Only a brief mention without prominent presentation indicates limited traction, making this low-cost option unlikely to justify further resources.
Featured on the home page with a specific launch date, signaling strategic importance and strong perceived value.
Only mentioned without dedicated page or updates, suggesting insufficient early results to warrant continued investment as a platform option.
Its own page indicates active marketing and moderate potential, so the option is kept while uncertainty remains.
Presented on its own page, showing investment and enough promise to keep the option open for another year.
